item: Layout budget, Phase 2b-i: How it works, About, Routes and the route pages in tabs
spec: docs/revamp/specs/layout-budget.md section 2 and tests L-03; shared components/ux/sub-tabs.tsx (S4)
changed: apps/web/components/public-page.tsx, public-page.css, content/public-pages.ts: the two phases of How it works are tabs (Before You Meet, Meet and Follow Up); each phase heading stays in the page.
apps/web/app/about/page.tsx, about.css: the seven articles are in five tabs (Why Corridra, Who It Is For, How It Works, Where We Focus, Working With Us); every article keeps its id.

apps/web/components/discovery-experience.tsx, app/corridors/page.tsx, corridors.css, corridor-map.tsx, world-route-map.tsx: Routes has three tabs (Explore a Route first, Pick Your Route, Sample Mission); on a wide screen the picker and fine-tune sit on the left and the map, cropped to its middle band, and the result on the right.
apps/web/app/corridors/[corridor]/page.tsx, corridor.css: each route page shows one of its three cards at a time (What We Help With, Current Availability, Where the Work Happens).
preserved: Every word, link, id and control stays in the server HTML; one panel is shown at a time and no rule overrides [hidden] (tested on every page).
P-06 old-address tests are unchanged and pass: Routes opens on the list of routes, so every route link and the /plan link are visible without a tap.
No component forked: the shared SubTabs is used as it is; a scoped padding override on the Routes tab labels is the only styling change around it.

pageLength.unit: document height over viewport height (390x844 phone, 1440x900 desktop); hard limits 2.0 phone, 1.0 desktop

added: tests/browser/layout-budget-tabs.spec.ts (63 cases: budget per tab at both sizes, every word kept, one panel shown and no display override, ?tab= and arrow keys, every in-page link opens its tab, axe per tab, primary action above the fold, old addresses)
tests.updated: tests that look at content now in another tab choose that tab first, same assertions: any-route, product-experience, real-use-content, ux02-discovery, ux06-presentation, verification ws-a public-copy (the six step names on How it works are in two tabs). P-06 tests untouched.
tests.openPoint: /corridors on a phone: its start link follows the cards, below the fold (a chooser page); it is above the fold on a wide screen.
